reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Justin Fishner-Wolfson, founder of 137 Ventures.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Justin Fishner-Wolfson, founder of 137 Ventures, a venture capital fund focused on providing liquidity solutions to founders, investors. In our conversation, we discuss what early career experiences led Justin to start 137 Ventures, the counter-intuitive information asymmetry between public and private markets. I hope you enjoy my conversation with Justin.
